scoring_justification: Exact recompute infeasible: MD simulation too heavy; Dubey model incomplete public parameters (Lb, l∞, α unknown). Structural trends instead.

outputs.description: MD thermal conductivity values for the nine thicknesses. Scoring verifies structural properties: (a) thermal conductivity decreases with decreasing thickness (monotonic overall trend), and (b) for each thickness, tangential conductivity exceeds normal conductivity.

Theoretical thermal conductivity values from the Dubey Boltzmann transport model. The checker recomputes the values using the same parameters and integrals, then compares the agent-reported values against the recomputed reference within a tight relative tolerance.

output_contract.notes: MD results are scored by structural audit because absolute values can vary with simulation parameters; the theory results are deterministic given the same model implementation, so an exact-match tolerance check is appropriate.

steps.description: Check that MD thermal conductivity decreases with decreasing thickness (positive slope when thickness sorted ascending) and that normal and tangential values are not identical.
Check that theoretical thermal conductivity decreases with decreasing thickness (positive slope).
